title: Grateful Dead Live at Roanoke Civic Center on 1987-07-07
source: AUD> Beyer Dynamic M88's> Sony TCD5M(CM)> Nak DR-10 (Playback)> Midiman Flying Cow 24bit/48kHz A/D> RME Digi96/8> Steinberg's Wavelab 3.0 (bit resolution & resampling to CDR redbook 16/44.1> CDWav beta1.57 (tracking only)> SHNv3 (MKW ACT)

ai_review.summary: Clear audience recording captures a great show highlighted by an epic Looks Like Rain and a lively Birdsong jam.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers all rate this tape four stars, praising the performance as “great” with one of the best “Looks Like Rain” ever and a crowd‑rousing Birdsong jam.  The audience source is noted for its surprising clarity and immersive ambient mix, making it an enjoyable listen despite being a non‑soundboard recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive 4‑star reviews highlight strong musical performance and clear audience recording; weighting gives a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as clear, with an ambient crowd mix that puts listeners in the venue; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall positive pacing and energy, with highlighted moments on Looks Like Rain and an enthusiastic Birdsong jam that excited the crowd.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bob (Bobby) Weir is praised for going ‘sick house’ on Looks Like Rain.
